title: Baidu Opens Weights for New 280B Parameter ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base Model
summary:
Baidu has made the raw weights of its ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base available for public research, enabling developers to perform domain adaptation and instruction tuning. The open mixture-of-experts (MoE) model features 280B total parameters with 14B activated per token and was pre-trained on 33.5T tokens. It supports a context window of 1M tokens for inference and fine-tuning and is available on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

The model recorded an 82.3% pass rate on the HumanEval+ benchmark, surpassing the 69.5% posted by DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base under the same setup. Baidu launched a vLLM-ERNIE plugin for deployment on Nvidia GB200 and H100 hardware, while the SGLang and vLLM frameworks announced immediate support. Baidu said a post-trained version of ERNIE 5.5 Flash will be released soon.

selectedTweets.text:
🎉 Day-0 support for @Baidu_Inc’s ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base with vLLM!

280B total parameters, 14B active per token. Pre-trained on 33.5T tokens, with 128K training context and up to 1M tokens for fine-tuning and inference. Open Base weights for domain adaptation, instruction tuning and RL research.

Code highlights: 82.3% HumanEval+ and 40.1% LiveCodeBench pass@1 (both 1-shot), versus 69.5% and 31.9% for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base under the same evaluation setup.

Efficiency is built into the architecture: 37 compressed-attention layers + 6 MLA-DSA layers, Multi-Router Latent MoE, and ECHO — reusing the final layer as a speculative draft.

Serve FP8 or BF16 with Baidu’s vLLM-ERNIE plugin on vLLM 0.32.0. ECHO runs through vLLM’s MTP path; recipes include expert parallelism, KV offload and prefill/decode disaggregation, with runs verified on @NVIDIA GB200 and H100.

Weights are on @huggingface and @ModelScope2022.

Recipe: https://t.co/OhlAm9XYKB
FP8: https://t.co/pzNsf3LBb9
BF16: https://t.co/igWS26BQ62
